backup.restore_point: PENDING: take a fresh backup, then fill restore_point and verified_at
backup.production_rule: Phase is backfill, not expand, only because the expand-safety scan refuses the literal DELETE FROM inside guest_id_photo_purge_done_v1 (a new function that clears queue rows only when called, and only for paths whose storage object is gone; nothing runs it at apply time). One new table (guest_id_photo_purge_queue: RLS on, no policy, no grant for anon, authenticated or service_role), one new AFTER UPDATE OF id_photo_path OR DELETE row trigger on guest_companions (security definer, never blocks the staff action, never raises), two new service_role-only functions (guest_id_photo_purge_status_v1, guest_id_photo_purge_done_v1) and two new job_heartbeats rows (guest-id-photos-backup 2 days, guest-id-photos-drill monthly, last_succeeded_at = now() so no alert before the first run). No existing data, table, column or grant changes. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, then fill both. Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: trigger_after_row_on_delete_and_update_of_photo_path
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid = 'public.guest_companions'::regclass and t.tgname = 'guest_companions_release_photo' and (t.tgtype & 1) = 1 and (t.tgtype & 2) = 0 and (t.tgtype & 4) = 0 and (t.tgtype & 8) = 8 and (t.tgtype & 16) = 16 and pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) like '%UPDATE OF id_photo_path%')

forward_verification.name: both_heartbeat_rows_seeded
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 from public.job_heartbeats where (job_name = 'guest-id-photos-backup' and expected_interval_seconds = 172800) or (job_name = 'guest-id-photos-drill' and expected_interval_seconds = 2678400)
